mapper.sql: SELECT rr.id, rr.comp_id, rr.bill_id, DATE(STR_TO_DATE(rr.bill_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS bill_date, rr.member_card_no, rr.stored_amount, COALESCE(scr.mobile, card_mobile.mobile) AS mobile FROM bdc_boka_recharge_records rr LEFT JOIN bdc_boka_sell_card_records scr ON scr.bill_id = rr.bill_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.member_card_no, MAX(r.mobile) AS mobile FROM bdc_boka_sell_card_detail_records d JOIN bdc_boka_sell_card_records r ON r.bill_id = d.bill_id GROUP BY d.member_card_no ) card_mobile ON card_mobile.member_card_no = rr.member_card_no
